title.zh: 美国财政部制裁支持朝鲜IT工人计划的个人与实体
title.en: Treasury Sanctions 11 Over North Korean IT Worker Scheme That Moved Millions in Crypto

current_state.zh: OFAC sanctioned 10 people and one entity for supporting North Korean IT worker schemes that funded weapons programs, while Chainalysis detailed how Russian intermediaries and Garantex moved and cashed out millions in crypto for the DPRK.
current_state.en: OFAC sanctioned 10 people and one entity for supporting North Korean IT worker schemes that funded weapons programs, while Chainalysis detailed how Russian intermediaries and Garantex moved and cashed out millions in crypto for the DPRK.

updates.what_changed_zh: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC sanctioned 10 individuals and one entity, including two Russian nationals accused of converting millions in crypto for North Korean networks, and published associated Ethereum and Tron addresses tied to the IT-worker fraud scheme.
